name: Isoflurane
aliases: Forane, Aerrane, Compound 469, Forene, HCFE-235da2, Isoflurano, Isofluranum
summary: Isoflurane, sold under the brand name Forane among others, is a halogenated ether used as a general anesthetic. It can be used to start or maintain anesthesia; however, other medications are often used to start anesthesia, due to airway irritation with isoflurane. Isoflurane is an inhalational anesthetic given via inhalation.
